description.text: V Starter Deck: Partner, a random 60-card deck, ready to play out of the box, with damage counters and a rule book, each built around a Pokémon V. The official page shows decks led by Pikachu V and Ditto V, whose Ability brings a Pokémon V back from the discard pile. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
